issues.evidence: Push-ins end on arbitrary crops: f_26 reads 'ised FY26 outlook', f_29 'k Q3 / evised FY26 outlook', f_38 'Q3 / d FY26 outlook', f_46 'date' + '· Covenant' at frame edge. The camera lands on nothing; the subject of the shot (the changed number) is not in frame.
issues.suggested_action: Re-target every push to end on the changed value (Revenue!E6 8.5, the €74.6m tracked change, the Slide 4 row) placed on a thirds intersection; cap scale so whole words stay in frame.

issues.evidence: At 0.0 s and 2.5 s the frame is a flat grey email window cropped by the frame edge, cards floated on top, no device, no room, no light source. The brief says a real laptop opens the film; it is not visible in either sampled frame.
issues.suggested_action: Hold the dark-room laptop (as in f_48) for the first 1.5 s with the email tracked onto its screen and the ≠ cards above, key from the screen glow only; then push in.

issues.evidence: f_10 and f_13: the head-in-hands clip does not fill the frame — a black band runs down the right ~10% and across the top; her face sits dead centre under a flat top light.
issues.suggested_action: Scale to fill (crop 112%), reframe her to left third with lead room toward the world-map practical on frame-left.

issues.evidence: Illustrated Word/chat/Excel/email windows are front-on, frame-filling, evenly lit grey with a vignette; no plane, no depth, no motivated light. f_18 is a white window with a Send button in the lower-left and empty space.
issues.suggested_action: Put each illustrated window back on her laptop in the night office (as f_04/f_06 do) or on a 10–15° tilted plane with screen-glow falloff and a soft-focus foreground edge.

issues.evidence: f_48 is a dark-room laptop on a bare desk; f_49/f_50 (5 s later, the 'lights come on' payoff) is a different laptop in a candle-and-rattan-lamp room. f_49 and f_50 are pixel-identical framing: no move for ~4.5 s.
issues.suggested_action: Use the same laptop/desk for the dark→lit payoff (practical lamp clicks on frame-right), and add a slow 3–5% push to the 'Sent' toast.

issues.evidence: f_03 protagonist wears glasses, short-side key from a desk lamp; f_10/f_13 no glasses, hard top light, different background (world-map projection). Reads as two women.
issues.suggested_action: Verify both clips are the same talent; if not, replace one with another clip from the f_03 session or cut the glasses clip to a back/over-shoulder angle.

issues.evidence: Split frames f_33,f_34,f_35,f_36 are the same locked composition with a small chatbot card top-left and a product panel right; header text 'AGENTIC OFFICE · ONE SLIDE ELEMENT' collides with the list row 'Replaces "€71–73m" with' (f_35/f_36).
issues.suggested_action: Give the split a slow lateral drift and depth (chatbot side defocused); move the header above the panel so it never overlaps UI text.

issues.evidence: End card is centred text on a flat teal gradient; then black.
issues.suggested_action: Hold the logo over the sunrise plate (f_51) at 20% exposure or with the window light raking the type.
